user_quote: I tried searching for 'the small coffee shop in Goa with yellow chairs' and Google Photos gave me random yellow flowers from 5 years ago. I know the photo exists, but I can't remember the exact month or year!

Search is useless when you forget when you took something. I wanted to find a picture of my dog's medicine prescription from last summer. Searching 'medicine' returns 200 documents and I have to scroll through every single one.

I remembered taking a photo of a wooden bar sign during a road trip, but couldn't remember which town. Search gave zero results for 'wooden sign'. I tried changing words to 'pub', 'wood', 'signboard' but got nothing and gave up.
Why can't I search by photo composition or vibe? Like 'sunset through a window' or 'red dress at a wedding'? Photos only picks up clear face tags or explicit geotags.
I spent 30 minutes trying to find a screenshot of a recipe I saved in 2022. I don't remember the dish name, just that it had spinach and garlic in the ingredients list. Search OCR failed completely.
When a search fails, Google Photos gives you zero suggestions on how to fix it. It just shows 'No results found'. You're left guessing what keywords to remove or add.
I remembered the photo was taken at night near a pool, but I couldn't filter search results by 'nighttime' or 'outdoors'. It returned thousands of daytime pool photos.
I have 40,000 photos. Finding a picture from 4 years ago based on a vague memory is so frustrating that I usually don't even bother trying anymore unless it's critical.
